heroHeadline: Kast Mega Bill Battles Congress as Police Raids on Mapuche Community School Escalate Araucanía Tensions
heroSubtitle: President José Antonio Kast's flagship economic reconstruction bill — featuring a corporate tax cut to 23% — advances through Congress only after populist Parisi bloc forces key amendments, exposing the fragility of his minority government. Meanwhile, Carabineros conducted armed raids on Lof Temucuicui's community school (May 14), firing over 400 rounds; the community filed formal accusations of evidence planting. A M5.5 earthquake struck Villarrica (May 9) as Kast's approval sits at 29–39% — the lowest of his term.
footerNote: Data sourced from official Chilean government records (Biblioteca del Congreso, Banco Central, SERVEL), Rettig and Valech commissions, IACHR, CIPER Chile, and major international outlets.
